outcome.Summary: Extended the config package: added Timeout (APP_TIMEOUT via time.ParseDuration, default 30s) and Tags (APP_TAGS comma-separated, trimmed, empties dropped) fields; made Load collect ALL invalid env values and return them as a single errors.Join error with the zero Config; added Merge that copies non-zero override fields (non-nil Tags, even empty, replaces base) without modifying arguments (Tags defensively copied). Added tests for defaults, overrides, error collection, and all merge cases; `go vet ./...` and `go test ./... -count=1` pass.
